name: instagram-agent
description: Thirteen Claude skills that run an Instagram account: Reels off 26 hook formulas with a scored hook and a timed beat sheet, a research skill that finds what is working in your niche and ranks it by outlier multiple, captions linted against the feed truncation, carousels, stories, profile score, weekly plan, comments, replies, DMs, repurposing, audits, and a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint before anything ships. Plus the Web3 training pack (pt-BR): ten agents that take someone from zero to earning in Web3 by skill first, with a mentor, a security gate, DeFi and risk calculators, an on-chain due-diligence score and a 76-question exam bank.
